'''Goratak III''',<ref name="MB" /> or simply '''Goratak''',<ref name="MB" /><ref name="IC" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="MB" /> located in the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Goratak III was a barren world peculiar for its odd [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] nature.<ref name="MB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="MB" /> between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="GGWD">According to many source books, such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Galactic Civil War started in 2 BBY.</ref> and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to [[The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors|''The History of the Mandalorians'']], the battle on Goratak III was the impetus for [[Jodo Kast]] taking up [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]]. He is known to be in this career as early as [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], per ''[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale]]'', and so this mission must take prior to this.</ref> the forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] intercepted an [[Imperial]] [[Tech 4 PDV|vessel]] carrying highly sensitive information about the Rebels' new enterprise on [[Tar Morden]]. The vessel was destroyed, but a [[I2-CG droid/Legends|droid]] containing the information crashed on Goratak III. Rebel sensors detected the droid in an area marked by wild crystalline growth,<ref name="MB" /> known as the [[Crystal Forests]],<ref name="IC" /><ref name="CE" /> and a strike force was [[Mission to Goratak III|immediately dispatched]]. In turn, Imperial [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] gathered what forces it could on such short notice, hiring a squad of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and augmenting it with squads of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] to retrieve the droid.<ref name="MB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Introduction===
Goratak III was introduced in the scenario ''[[The Crystal Forest of Goratak]]'', produced for ''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|Star Wars Miniatures Battles]]'', a core rulebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1991]] to support its [[Star Wars Miniatures Battles|tabletop miniature wargame system]].<ref name="MB" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Goratak star system in grid square K-16.<ref name="EAOC" />

===Game Board Construction===
[[File:CrystalForestsWEG-map.jpg|left|thumb|250px|''[[The Crystal Forest of Goratak]]'' Set-up Map]]
The rulebook provided recommendations for creating the game board. The search took place in a «[[Crystal Forests|forest]]» on Goratak, where strangely shaped crystalline growths formed a maze of obstructions. Apart from the crystal growths, the terrain was clear. The area featured two types of crystal growth: waist-high crystals (represented by shaded «trees» on the map), provided medium cover, while taller growths (represented by black «trees»), were impassable and blocked line of sight. The crystal growths could be represented using chopped-up pieces of foam rubber. According to the game scenario, the [[I2-CG droid/Legends|droid]] being sought was supposed to be hidden in the center of the cluster of crystal growths.<ref name="MB" />
